compiled_state.title: As an orchestrator, the sprint shared scripts accept caller-specific prefixes and PR title/body so /debug-everything can reuse them without modification
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Parameterize three sprint-shared scripts so /debug-everything (and any future caller) can invoke them with non-sprint-specific values.

**Why**: The new debug ci-pr workflow reuses sprint's branch/PR machinery but needs distinct branch prefixes (`bug-batch/` vs `story/`) and PR titles (`Debug:` vs `Sprint:`). Without parameterization the scripts hardcode sprint conventions.

**Scope**:
- IN: `create-story-branch.sh` gains `--prefix <name>` flag (default `story`); `detect-session-leakage.sh` reads `STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX` env var (default `story/`) for Case 1/2/4 branch construction; `create-sprint-draft-pr.sh` reads `DRAFT_PR_TITLE_PREFIX` (default `Sprint:`) and `DRAFT_PR_BODY_TEMPLATE` (default existing body) env vars; regression tests for each verifying sprint defaults preserved end-to-end.
- OUT: `merge-story-branch.sh` — audit-confirmed no parameterization needed (writes `DSO-Story-Merge:` not `DSO-Story:`). Updating non-sprint, non-debug callers of these scripts.

## Done Definitions

- When complete, `create-story-branch.sh` invoked with no `--prefix` still produces `story/<epic>/<story>` branches and `create-story-branch.sh --prefix bug-batch` produces `bug-batch/<epic>/<story>` branches
  ← Satisfies: "Parameterization tasks land alongside this epic with regression tests verifying existing sprint defaults preserved end-to-end"
- When complete, `detect-session-leakage.sh` with `STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX` unset routes Case 1/2/4 to `story/` targets and with `STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX=bug-batch/` routes to `bug-batch/` targets
  ← Satisfies: "Parameterization tasks land alongside this epic with regression tests verifying existing sprint defaults preserved end-to-end"
- When complete, `create-sprint-draft-pr.sh` with no env overrides opens a PR titled `Sprint: <epic-title>` and with `DRAFT_PR_TITLE_PREFIX=Debug:` opens a PR titled `Debug: <epic-title>`
  ← Satisfies: "Parameterization tasks land alongside this epic with regression tests verifying existing sprint defaults preserved end-to-end"
- When complete, regression-test suite for each parameterized script asserts sprint default behavior unchanged
  ← Satisfies: "Parameterization tasks land alongside this epic with regression tests verifying existing sprint defaults preserved end-to-end"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic
  ← Satisfies: "Parameterization tasks land alongside this epic with regression tests"

## Considerations

- [Testing] Regression tests must exercise both default and override paths — assert sprint-mode invocations produce identical artifacts before and after parameterization
- [Maintainability] Sprint shared-script surface now has two consumers (/sprint and /debug-everything) — document the contract in script headers so future changes consider both callers

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
